# Halo Fortune Group

> Halo Fortune Group Pty Ltd (ACN 167 597 122), trading as Sino Talent Resources (STR), is an Australian consultancy that helps global businesses initiate, manage, and expand their operations in China. Core practice areas: China market entry, cross-border e-commerce, digital marketing on Chinese platforms, and human resources / talent solutions.

Halo Fortune Group operates three customer-facing service brands:

- **Happy Mall** — cross-border e-commerce enablement (Tmall Global, JD Worldwide, Douyin, RED/Xiaohongshu store setup and operations).
- **Adcess Digital Marketing** — paid media and content marketing on WeChat, Weibo, Douyin, Baidu SEM, and KOL/KOC campaigns.
- **Halo Human Resources** — China-side recruitment, employer of record (EOR), payroll, and visa/relocation support for Australian businesses entering China.

Primary audience: Australian and other foreign SMEs and brand owners targeting Chinese consumers or hiring talent in mainland China.
Headquarters: Australia. Service delivery: Australia + mainland China.

## Services

- [China Market Entry Consulting](https://halofortune.com.au/services/market-entry): feasibility studies, entity setup (WFOE/JV), licensing, distribution strategy.
- [Cross-border E-commerce — Happy Mall](https://halofortune.com.au/happy-mall): Tmall Global flagship store, JD Worldwide, Douyin e-commerce, RED operations.
- [Digital Marketing — Adcess](https://halofortune.com.au/adcess): WeChat official accounts, Weibo, Douyin/TikTok China, Baidu SEM/SEO, KOL/KOC influencer marketing.
- [HR & Talent — Halo HR](https://halofortune.com.au/hr): recruitment, EOR, payroll, visa, relocation for China operations.
